intent: The capability-driven default inspector: renders the full, selection-aware property stack for the current mode — hosts pass data and callbacks, not sections.
guidance: Controlled and stateless: pass values plus onXChange callbacks; PropertyPanel owns no document state (uncontrolled props fall back to demo data). `mode` swaps the entire body — element is the default; project, slide, video-clip, audio-clip, and media-effects each render their own sections. `capabilities` gate deferred systems (styles, variables, libraries, videoFill, dropZone); a disabled capability is omitted, never a no-op. Position, Layout, and Appearance are always present; every other section renders only when its data is supplied. Multi-select shows Mixed placeholders and appends Selection colors. keyframeControls add per-property diamonds only while the host supplies them. Reach for Inspector + PanelSection instead when you need to hand-compose or reorder the section stack.

anatomy.description: Top strip above the tabs, shared by every mode: Present/Preview, Share, account avatar, and presence menu (MultiplayerBar).
Design · Animate seam (InspectorTabs) with the zoom control in the header zone; absent in project/clip modes.
40px row naming the selection — Text / Frame / Rectangle / Component / Group; Mixed on mixed-type multi-select.
The scrolling PanelSections in order: Position, Layout, Appearance (always present), then Typography, Fill, Stroke, Effects, Selection colors, Export by presence.
ScrollArea with an overlay scrollbar; only the active tab's content sits in the reading order.

use_when: You want the batteries-included inspector: pass selection data + capabilities and it renders the right sections.
The selection should drive which body renders (element / project / slide / video-clip / audio-clip / media-effects).
dont_use_when: You need to hand-compose, reorder, or replace sections — use Inspector with PanelSection children.
You are building a one-off custom panel — compose PanelSection directly.

type.note: Header/element-type labels hardcode text-[11px] font-[550] and the SUBLABEL hardcodes text-[9px] font-[450] tracking-[0.05em] rather than binding a --composa type token.

tokens.note: The TemplateStyleSection preview swatch hardcodes bg-[#e95000] / bg-[#ffcd00] / bg-[#100f10] over bg-white (chrome, not tokens); demo fill/stroke/selection-color defaults also carry #hex placeholders.

a11y.role: No landmark role on the surface — the root is a plain div (data-composa-inspector-surface); wrap it or pass a label to expose it as a complementary landmark.
a11y.tabpanels: Design/Animate bodies render role=tabpanel, each aria-labelledby its tab.
a11y.groups: Flow, Grid + gap, and Alignment + gap clusters use role=group with aria-label.
a11y.controls: Icon-only actions and nested inputs/menus carry their own aria-labels and tooltips.

code.example:
<PropertyPanel
  mode="element"
  elementType="frame"
  x={0} y={0}
  width={1200} height={115}
  opacity={100}
  capabilities={{ variables: true }}
  onXChange={setX}
  onOpacityChange={setOpacity}
/>
